name: Crystal
label: Sapphire crystal
note: Domed sapphire with anti-reflective coating on both faces.

name: Bezel
label: Bezel
note: Polished ring that clamps the crystal gasket.

name: HourHand
label: Hour hand
note: Rides on the hour wheel; 12 hours per revolution.

name: MinuteHand
label: Minute hand
note: Driven by the cannon pinion; one revolution an hour.

name: SecondsHand
label: Seconds hand
note: Fourth wheel arbor; one revolution a minute.

name: Dial
label: Dial
note: Brass disc with applied indices; finish is swappable.

name: ComplicationDate
label: Date module
note: Date ring and a small window plate.

name: ComplicationMoon
label: Moon-phase module
note: 59-tooth moon disc; needs the date module's drive.

name: ComplicationPowerReserve
label: Power-reserve module
note: Differential that reads the barrel's remaining turns.

name: BridgeBalance
label: Balance bridge
note: Holds the balance staff and the regulator.

name: BridgeTrain
label: Train bridge
note: Upper pivots of the going train.

name: BridgeBarrel
label: Barrel bridge
note: Closes the mainspring barrel.

name: BalanceWheel
label: Balance wheel
note: Oscillates at 4 Hz (28,800 vibrations an hour).

name: PalletFork
label: Pallet fork
note: Releases the escape wheel one tooth per half-oscillation.

name: EscapeWheel
label: Escape wheel
note: Last wheel of the train; 15 teeth.

name: GearFourth
label: Fourth wheel
note: Carries the seconds hand.

name: GearThird
label: Third wheel
note: Between the center and fourth wheels.

name: GearCenter
label: Center wheel
note: Turns once an hour and drives the minute hand.

name: Barrel
label: Mainspring barrel
note: Stores the energy: about 70 hours when fully wound.

name: MainPlate
label: Main plate
note: The foundation every other part pivots in.

name: Rotor
label: Winding rotor
note: Swings with the wrist and winds the mainspring.

name: Caseback
label: Caseback
note: Display back with a sapphire window; engraved here.

name: Case
label: Case middle
note: 40 mm middle; lugs carry the strap.

name: Crown
label: Crown
note: Winds, sets the time; screws down against the case.

name: StrapLeather
label: Leather strap
note: Stitched calf leather.

name: StrapRubber
label: Rubber strap
note: Vulcanised rubber.

name: StrapBracelet
label: Link bracelet
note: Three-link bracelet.
